doctor.name: Doctor
doctor.description: Protects one player from being eliminated each night.

detective.name: Detective
detective.description: Investigates one player each night to learn their alignment.

vigilante.name: Azure Vigilante
vigilante.description: May shoot one player during the day instead of voting (2 bullets). Shooting a Town player eliminates the Vigilante too.

bomb.name: Crimson Kamikaze
bomb.description: Explodes upon death, eliminating whoever was responsible for killing them.

vanilla.name: Vanilla Townie
vanilla.description: Has no special ability. Uses vote power during the day.

mayor.name: Mayor
mayor.description: Elected town leader whose day vote counts as 3 votes.

godfather.name: Mafia King
godfather.description: The leader of the Mafia. Appears as 'Town' if investigated by the Cop.

silencer.name: Mafia Silencer
silencer.description: Blocks one player each night, preventing them from using their action.

mafia_member.name: Mafia Member
mafia_member.description: Basic Mafia member who participates in night kills.

day.label: Day
day.description: The village wakes and talks. Everyone discusses the events of the night, shares suspicions, and defends themselves. The Vigilante may spend a bullet instead of voting — but shooting a Town player backfires.

night.label: Night
night.description: The village sleeps. Players with night abilities act one by one, in secret. Nobody sees who chose whom — only the outcomes surface in the morning.

vote_result.label: Vote Result
vote_result.description: Discussion ends and every living player votes. The top suspect is eliminated and their role is revealed for all to see. If the Crimson Kamikaze dies, they take their killer down with them.

roleExplorer.title: Meet the roles
roleExplorer.subtitle: Your role is secret. Learn what everyone at the table might be plotting.

phaseExplorer.repeatNote: Night, day, and vote repeat until a side wins.

flow.title: How a game unfolds
flow.introA: One game is a loop of nights and days. Here is the full journey —
flow.introLink: explore what happens inside each phase

gather.title: Gather your crew
gather.text: The host creates a room and shares the invite link or room code. Everyone joins from their browser — no installs, just audio, video, and suspicion.

roles.title: Roles are dealt in secret
roles.text: Each player is assigned a hidden role: most are Town, a few are Mafia. Look at your own role and tell no one. The Mafia learn who each other are — the Town knows nothing.

night.title: Night falls — roles act
night.text: When night comes, each role with a night ability acts in secret: the Mafia pick a target, the Detective investigates a suspect, the Doctor protects someone. See the phases page for who does what.

morning.title: Morning — the reveal
morning.text: Everyone wakes up to the news: someone may have been eliminated overnight — unless the Doctor made a save. The eliminated player's role is revealed.

discuss.title: Discuss and accuse
discuss.text: The living debate. Who acted suspiciously? Who is deflecting? Town players share what they know (carefully), and Mafia players blend in, sow doubt, and push suspicion onto innocents.

vote.title: Vote to eliminate
vote.text: Everyone casts a vote. The player with the most votes is eliminated and their role is revealed. Then night falls again — repeat until one side wins.

victory.title: A side claims victory
victory.text: Town wins by eliminating every Mafia member. Mafia wins once they match the Town in numbers and control the vote. See the win conditions below.

actionGlossary.title: Every action, explained
actionGlossary.subtitle: These are all the moves in the game — who can use them, when, and what the village sees.

town.headline: Eliminate every Mafia member
town.text: The Town — everyone who is not Mafia — wins when the last Mafia player is eliminated, whether by day vote, Vigilante shot, or Kamikaze explosion. Every revealed role is a clue: count down the remaining suspects.

mafia.headline: Reach parity with the Town
mafia.text: The Mafia wins once their numbers match the surviving Town — at parity they control every vote, so the outcome is sealed. Kill quietly at night, deflect by day, and survive the eliminations.

track.title: Track everything
track.text: Note who voted for whom and who pushed each elimination. Mafia voting patterns leak over time — the record rarely lies.

speak.title: Town: speak up, but time it
speak.text: Share what you know during discussion. If you hold a power role, hint instead of claiming outright — the Mafia is listening.

blend.title: Mafia: blend, don't hide
blend.text: Silent players look suspicious. Accuse, defend, and vote like a Town member would — and never let your partners look coordinated.

detective.title: Detective: protect your findings
detective.text: Found a Mafia member? Steer the vote toward them without exposing how you know. A revealed Detective rarely survives the next night.

doctor.title: Doctor: guard the valuable
doctor.text: Protect outspoken Town voices and confirmed power roles. Avoid obvious patterns — the Mafia watches who keeps surviving.

quiet.title: Everyone: watch the quiet ones
quiet.text: Players coasting through discussion without committing to reads are often hiding something. Ask them direct questions.

distribution.title: Roles at every table size
distribution.cardSubtitle: The Mafia is always outnumbered — their edge is secrecy.
